styleLock.direction: airy cool-botanical household summer lotion commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft cloud-like pale sky-mist field #E3F0F7 grading into milky white #FFFFFF, mint leaf-green #DDF0E1 panels and rounded-corner white cards, water-splash arcs and eucalyptus leaf sprigs as the only decoration, never a dark or black field
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright diffuse high-key daylight key from the upper left at about 6000K with a fill card on the shadow side, low contrast, one soft contact shadow grounding the bottle, gentle water caustics near the splash arc, no hard speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: a live water meniscus with concentric ripples for the hero, mist-grey glass podium for the benefit screens, white laminate shelf under the spec cards, pale linen bedding in the sleep scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one short Chinese headline per screen wrapped in 「」 at 28-44pt, deep charcoal #2D2D2D, plus pill bars and one numbered row marker, no dense body paragraphs

styleLock.presentationRules: the bottle stands upright at a stable scale, ribbed cap on top, slender squared shoulder and liquid colour unchanged, front label kept as a blank legible field with no rendered words, bubbles and leaves ring the bottle but never occlude its silhouette
noDrift: no protection-duration or hours wording rendered anywhere, no time numbers of any kind
no repellent, kill or bite-reduction percentages, no insect species names or illustrations
no cure, treatment or skin-repair claims, no raw or inflamed skin imagery
no ingredient names and no ingredient percentages rendered on bubbles, cards or label
no age indication, no infant or child figure, no unsupervised-child usage scene
no pesticide or health registration numbers, no certification marks, seals, awards or QR codes
no red or warm promotional hues added to the cool botanical palette
no dark or black fields, no metallic gold, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds between screens
no invented readouts, no duplicated bubbles, no floating bottle without a contact shadow
no label artwork redraw: the front label stays a blank legible field
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy cool-botanical household summer-lotion commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of milky white #FFFFFF, pale sky-mist blue #E3F0F7 and mint leaf-green #DDF0E1 with one herbal deep green accent #2F7D4F and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool daylight temperature; background system limited to a soft cloud-like sky-mist field grading into milky white, mint panels and rounded-corner white cards, with water-splash arcs and eucalyptus leaf sprigs as the only decoration and never a dark or black field; bright diffuse high-key daylight key from the upper left at about 6000K with a fill card, low contrast, one soft contact shadow grounding the bottle, gentle water caustics, no hard speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with one short Chinese headline in 「」 plus pill bars and one numbered row marker, no dense body copy; thin single-weight line icons and blank filled circular medallions in herbal deep green #2F7D4F plus a wavy green divider band; the bottle stays upright at a stable scale with its ribbed cap, slender squared shoulder, liquid colour and label placement unchanged and its front label kept as a completely blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no red or warm promotional hues, no invented numbers, dates or claims.
